But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

This big change in her life causes her to distance herself from her mother, Janet. Ignoring Janet during a movie night, Janet is confused and upset by her daughter's behaviour and is unable to understand why Harper is pushing her away. The coddling from her mother and the looming anxiety of her future blurs Harper's emotions, causing her to run off to her room. Janet attempts to keep the peace, but with Harper ignoring her, the tension builds, leading to an explosive altercation. During this moment, Janet realises Harper's behaviour isn’t usual teenage rudeness, but something much deeper. They both realise that their anger is rooted in sadness and anxiety. As they talk, Harper learns that she should embrace this change, and even if it doesn't work out, her mother will always be there for her.

Through raw conversations, cinematic storytelling, and an original soundtrack, HALF ORDER explores identity, nostalgia, and the cultural connections built through shared neighborhood experiences. More than a documentary about Chinese food, HALF ORDER is a heartfelt portrait of St. Louis, its people, and the culture that continues to connect them.

overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

title: The Day's Mother, the Night's End
original_title: The Day's Mother, the Night's End
overview: This lively and intimate film poem weaves fragments of everyday life, dreams, and memories into a kaleidoscopic reverie on cinema, desire, and female legacy. Like a diary, the camera—a gift from the filmmaker's mother—makes the ordinary shine while repeatedly capturing women who shaped the filmmaker's worldview.

title: In The Devil's Den
overview: Thirteen years after a viral apocalypse leaves the world ruled by worshipped horrors, three brothers hiding in a secluded Louisiana cabin are forced to confront the outside world when a stranger arrives at their door.

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: Rahul & Rosa
overview: Strange things happen to Rahul and Rosa as their relationship falls apart.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
original_title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
overview: Caffeine-deprived Cand Caff’s day goes from bad to apocalyptic when his sentient fridge threatens to blow up the entire neighborhood unless he delivers a fresh energy drink — fast. What follows is a chaotic sprint filled with push-up battles, Karen attacks, and unhinged inner demons in this pitch-black, low-budget comedy.  The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End cranks the absurdity, self-loathing, and dark humor to eleven while somehow feeling like the start of something much bigger.

title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
original_title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
overview: From protein pitfalls to considered choices, Gemma Atkinson, Dr Jack Mosley and Lucy Watson cut through the hype to discover the truth about the consumer health obsession

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

title: By Yourself
overview: Following a breakup, Syl goes solo camping in the deep woods to unplug and connect with herself. Her solitude turns sinister when she wakes to find a neighboring tent that wasn’t there the night before.

title: AGENT: STRONG
overview: A mild-mannered family man and staunch supporter of Robert Kennedy Jr, ALEX STRONG is tasked by a mysterious agency with stopping evildoers from putting fluoride in his town's water supply; pushing him into a surreal web of conspiracies where the fate of America, and the world is at stake.

title: Stitches
overview: Three isolated men submit to rituals of healing—an AI cleanse, a live stream of penance, and an experimental drug trial—each descending into madness as their pain becomes performance in a world obsessed with watching.

title: Strange Spirits
overview: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

title: Fly Train
overview: Like a bee tracing the windows of an endless train, thoughts on an ordinary journey drift between scenery and fragmented memories. Through experimental shadow play, everyday silhouettes transform into the surreal, slipping into a hypnotic stream of consciousness. As the wheels turn, the search for memory's meaning fades, leaving us to immerse ourselves in the ephemeral, flickering flow of frames.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: Wellness Retreat
overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

title: Zippy's House
overview: A troubled teen is forced to attend his strange classmate's birthday.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: We Set the House on Fire
original_title: We Set the House on Fire
overview: Five strangers happen upon a mysterious house on New Years Eve, their secrets and connections begin to be uncovered as the night takes a supernatural turn.

title: The Taller They Come
overview: A wannabe Australian film director travels to Ghana to produce his dream film, a kung-fu remake of The Harder They Come with Ghanian action sensation, Samuel “Ninja” Nkansah.

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: The Spirit Lock
overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

title: The Idiot(s)
overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
overview: An anthology film on the theme of fairy tales - some lighthearted, some more serious in tone, but all with a sprinkle of magic - and all set in the East of England county of Suffolk!

title: Little Singer
overview: Amidst the horizons of Diné land, the legacy of historical trauma echos through generations. At the center, a medicine man and a small school, where grief and resilience meet in song, teaching, and k’é (kinship). Little Singer is rooted in land; carrying the vision and medicine of k’é forward.

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: Sandy
overview: As her childhood best friend prepares to depart for the US, a college student navigates her academic pursuits, strained family relationships, and a growing dread of the inevitable goodbye. ‘Sandy’ is a film about grief, memory, and how sometimes life forces you to bend into uncomfortable shapes as you go through it. Entirely self-funded and shot over two years in Davao City and Panabo City, it’s a love letter to the places and people we lose...or that lose us.

title: Willie and His Pigs
overview: Every 9 months, rural Kentucky-based regenerative farmer Willie Houston brings home a small group of piglets. He raises them, names them, cares for them, and has to say goodbye. This subtle portrait challenges assumptions of masculinity in farming and explores who bears the emotional weight of ethically raising animals.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: 500 Miles
overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

title: Murder in the Highland Manor
overview: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who’ve escaped domestic abuse. But when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared, Kate becomes embroiled in the family’s deadly secrets.

title: Solemn Slits Of Eternity
overview: Brief And Buried Glimpses Of Abandoned Creation. Flashing And Fainting Towards A Distant Sorrow. Layers Of A Reality Rippling Wild Through The Solemn Slits Of Eternity. Returned And Exactly Violent As The Bodies Worth, Soundless As The Sighs Of A Gentle Heaven, Mirrored And Upheld. Transformed Through The Irreparable And Absurd Assurance Of Indefinable Loss.

title: In This Together
overview: During a bustling family function, four bickering siblings hatch a plan to fake their presence and fool their mother, however, when they become obsessed with discovering the new family drama, their façade falls apart, leading to their collective demise...

title: Fan Mail
overview: A filmmaker in trouble. An email that echoes through time and space.

title: Freaking Out.
overview: Paul calls everyone in his life after making a huge mistake.

title: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
original_title: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
overview: Jaynie miraculously cheats death after her husband Cole’s betrayal.

title: Martha's Notebook: Samuel & Jordan
overview: In this intense horror short, witness the desperate actions of Samuel & Jordan along with their friends, Derek and Mia, as they navigate the beginning of an apocalyptic nightmare unlike any other zombie film before. The group finds themselves face-to-face with AI-controlled zombies. This teaser showcases what a full feature film adaptation of the award-winning zombie book series could look like. Through blending gritty realism with emotional depth, and unique zombie thrills that horror fans crave!

title: The Silhouettes Soul
overview: The Silhouettes Soul, created for the Fearscreen 48 Hours Later Winter Challenge 2026, follows Kali as she slowly begins to lose herself, confronting a dark presence that may not be separate from her at all.

title: Translation
overview: A young Gaeilgeoir must learn the art of self-assurance and acceptance upon moving from her remote town to the city.

title: Sinister Secret Ingredient
overview: When dentist Mel buys a small-town clinic to start a new life, she meets Ruth, a beloved baker and neighbor with a tragic past. But when Mel’s 12-year-old daughter Abby goes missing, Mel uncovers Ruth’s horrifying secret.

title: Scullion
overview: A playful couple test their household chore habits and unknowingly summon a vengeful presence.

title: Bikini Office Girl
overview: A corporate auditor must log the actions of a bikini-clad employee. But when she begins breaking her own routine, he becomes convinced she's communicating with him, uncovering a reality where they are both prisoners in a simulation.

title: Pondside Pandemonium
overview: A split-second accident sets off a chain of events that traps a desperate man in a situation he can't control and can't escape.

title: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
original_title: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
overview: Alan Cumming hosts a comedy gala featuring 2SLGBTQIA+ stars performing at the Just For Laughs Montréal festival.

title: Centrífuga
overview: Maca is leaving in a week to study abroad away from her city, Seville. What she once envisioned as the future is now an imminent reality. Maca's inertia suddenly stops after having to face a host of new fears that will falter the decision that was once firm.

title: monoculture
overview: A quiet little suburb not far from here. It's Sunday. The sun's out. And so are the husbands...

title: My Art
overview: A drummer and a basketball player meet at an unexpected time, creating a unique friendship. While pushing each other to their limits, they demonstrate true passion.

title: The Corinthians: We Were the Champions
original_title: The Corinthians: We Were the Champions
overview: A documentary highlighting the talent and plight of a successful British women’s football team who fought against sexist attitudes to become champions.

title: Project Tombstone
overview: Allie Mac races herself up and down the iconic Tombstone in Moab, Utah. One version runs the full ascent and descent, relying on speed. The other sprints up and BASE jumps off. Ultra Runner Allie faces BASE Jumper Allie. Human power versus gravity... who wins?

title: A Dot in the Ocean
overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

title: Deposed
overview: Henrietta and Samuel are getting divorced. As a part of the legal proceedings, their parallel depositions force them to confront their deteriorating relationship.

title: Eternal
overview: A killer wandering through the fog begins to question the world around him and his own nature.

title: Where F1 Stars Are Made
overview: A special feature-length documentary celebrating 10 seasons of FIA Formula 2. It goes behind the scenes to look at how the feeder series shapes future talent, featuring retrospective interviews with prominent F2 alumni including Kimi Antonelli, Charles Leclerc, and Lando Norris.
